# Conversion: leads (all rows created 7d) vs subscribed by group
print("\n--- Conversion proxy: rows created 7d by group & status ---")
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT c.group_id as g, s.status, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day>={day-7}
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY c.group_id
""")
from collections import defaultdict
d=defaultdict(dict)
for row in r['rows']:
    d[row['g']][row['status']]=row['n']
for g in sorted(d):
    sub=d[g].get('subscribed',0); lost=d[g].get('lost',0); canc=d[g].get('cancelled',0)
    tot=sub+lost  # leads that arrived = subscribed+lost (cancelled are re-bill churns, not new leads)
    conv = sub/tot*100 if tot else 0
    print(f"  {g:6}: subscribed={sub} lost={lost} cancelled={canc} | new-lead conv~{conv:.1f}%")

# True new S2 customers (first-ever sub started in last 7d)
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) as n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.customer_id IN (
   SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions GROUP BY customer_id HAVING MIN(start_day)>={day-7}
)
""")
print("S2 truly-new customers (first sub in 7d):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# S2 customers with any active sub now
r = nm.query("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) as n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed'
""")
print("S2 active customers now:", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# S2 fully-churned in last 7d: had active sub, now none, last cancel in 7d
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM (
  SELECT s.customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_active,
         MAX(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>={day-7} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as recent_cancel
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE c.group_id='S2'
  GROUP BY s.customer_id
) WHERE has_active=0 AND recent_cancel=1
""")
print("S2 fully-churned customers (7d):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# upgrades within S2 (A->B/C): customer has cancelled A in 7d AND active B/C started 7d
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM (
  SELECT s.customer_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.plan='A' AND s.end_day>={day-7} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as canc_A,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan IN ('B','C') AND s.start_day>={day-7} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as new_BC
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE c.group_id='S2'
  GROUP BY s.customer_id
) WHERE canc_A=1 AND new_BC=1
""")
print("S2 A->B/C upgraders (7d):", r['rows'][0]['n'])
